data.title: 夜刀神十香 · 暖桌蜜柑的分享
data.description: 【士道家暖桌·冬夜】十香穿着柔软针织衫盘腿坐在暖桌前，认真剥开一颗蜜柑并把最甜的一瓣留到最后；她忽然把那一瓣递向镜头，紫瞳里写满“这次轮到你吃”。
data.location: Shido’s warm living room in winter
data.action: 暖桌前剥蜜柑把最甜一瓣递向镜头，眼神全是分享食物的期待
data.lighting: warm room light above the table and cool snowy window light
data.mood: 把普通晚餐变成精灵的分享仪式
data.promptProse: Cross-legged beneath the kotatsu, Tohka Yatogami carefully removes the strands from a winter mandarin and offers its sweetest segment toward the viewer with both hands. Keep the cream knitted sweater, purple trousers and warm socks, with her dark-purple hair moving beside eager eyes. The vertical medium view includes the tabletop in front and the snowy window beyond. Warm room light arriving from above the table illuminates her palms, the fruit and the blanket’s upper folds; the covered heater remains hidden below. Cooler window light outlines the farther table edge, and a small hand shadow falls onto the tabletop beneath the offered segment.
